provenance.note: IN-GRES 2024-2025 taluk assessment attached to 154 of 154 Gram Panchayats across 6 taluks by register membership; 0 deferred with a reason in review[].

limitations: The assessment unit is a revenue taluk, not the Gram Panchayat: each Panchayat inherits its taluk's category and stage of extraction unchanged, as containing-area context rather than a measurement of the place.

Membership is the Local Government Directory's own statement: the taluk the Panchayat's covered villages sit in, joined to the IN-GRES unit by name. No polygon is intersected; a Panchayat whose taluk IN-GRES does not assess is deferred, never guessed.
Blocks are the taluks themselves in this district, so no block spans more than one assessment unit.
